notes.title: 【Lewd Formosa】New Game release
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38386317/a5834554502bef2cbc952fe97c4858a3388d96fb.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1528560/

The game is a simulation game mainly with the fox demon Vivi. You will spend 30 days together.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38386317/d94f30052f0d5a0dcc98cde17f5e7b285ed5b6dd.png[/img]

Four actions can be carried out with the fox demon Vivi in a day.
Action commands include "Talk", "Interact", "Go out" and "H".

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38386317/e187459784bf5c0090b5f38ed914e56c4695c52b.jpg[/img]

Take her to various unique places to play and increase the positive feelings toward each other.
Talk with her to understand her past and uncover her secrets…

As the days pass by, you can unlock more special plot events with Vivi.
There are also many different Hentai events in the game. You can do various positions with Vivi.

But remember, living with a demon means you might see other demons along the way...

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38386317/946396d49a85a50464dc8eefff3952f57fc190bb.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog for Version 1.0.7
notes.notes:
[h3]Version 1.0.6 Updates[/h3]
1. Rebalanced some item buffs

[h3]Version 1.0.7 Updates[/h3]
1. Added Portuguese Support

Special thanks to Luyc for the Portuguese localization!

notes.title: Devlog for Version 1.0.5
notes.notes:
[h3]Version 1.0.1 Updates[/h3]
1. Fixed control overlap for gamepads

[h3]Version 1.0.2 Updates[/h3]
1. Added visual effects to equipment upgrades.
2. Fixed incorrect equipment sound effects.

[h3]Version 1.0.3 Updates[/h3]
1. Fixed some album viewing bugs
2. Fixed Eve's CG issues
3. Rebalanced some items to be a little more effective.

[h3]Version 1.0.4 Updates[/h3]
1. Reduced the overall size of the game.

[h3]Version 1.0.5 Updates[/h3]
1. Fixed damage area not changing when it should
2. Fixed multiple-overlapping sound effects in battle when clothes are destroyed
3. Fixed invincibility not activating when player is in recovery mode.
4. Fixed some issues people had with their Xbox controllers.
5. Succubus-chan's sound effect when damaged can no longer be overridden.
6. Fixed menu sync problems when upgrading equipment.

Thank you for your feedback over the past few days. Rest assured, we're still working on any and all issues in the game! If you found a bug or had an issue we still want to about it! 

Have fun!

notes.title: Devlog for Version 0.40

notes.title: Devlog for Version 0.29
notes.notes:
Devlog for Version 0.29

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38258701/150bb61030e973a1204101c4eca6133bc3ddd39c.jpg[/img]
1. Preparing Equipment System
2. Basic equipment will be available from the start.
3. Equipment (Panties) can be earned by beating levels.
4. Re-designing levels with the Zombie levels completed. Changes include easier progress and adjustments for the equipment system.
5. Replaced the ability to attack clothing in the background with a boss fight feature.

Players can access the Beta through the following steps:
1. Right-click the game in Library tab of your Steam client.
2. Select "Properties"
3. Navigate to "Betas" tab
4. Select "GTW_Tester" from the drop down list.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38258701/b6d6bc95d6946921bd284fc11acd90276d31c8eb.jpg[/img]

Please leave a comment in this thread if you find any issues. Thank you!
